solutions.name: Developer distribution
solutions.title: Blowhorn for developer distribution
solutions.headline: Post where developers actually talk.
solutions.lead: Hacker News, GitHub, Reddit and Slack, plus LinkedIn, X and Bluesky, from one queue. Posted as you, at a human pace.
solutions.description: One queue for the networks technical companies use: Hacker News, GitHub, Reddit and Slack, plus LinkedIn, X and Bluesky, posted as you from your own Chrome.

art.alt: Major Blowhorn, a teal rooster drill sergeant in a campaign hat, pointing and shouting through his gold bullhorn, Caribbean Green sound waves pouring out of it

pains.b: None of the schedulers we checked support Hacker News. GitHub and Slack stay a pile of tabs.
Votes, blast posts and "sent via" badges cost the trust you came to earn.

pains.t: A Slack app nobody can install
pains.b: Assistants that act as themselves need an app in the workspace. A free workspace at its app limit has no room.

gets.b: Hacker News submit and comment, GitHub follow and react, Slack messages, plus LinkedIn, X, Reddit and Bluesky.
It submits stories and comments, nothing else, with at most 2 link submissions per profile per day.

gets.t: No Blowhorn app in your Slack
gets.b: Blowhorn works through your own Slack sign-in and posts as you. No app to install, no bot user to invite.
Types key by key in your own Chrome, caps itself, and hands every CAPTCHA and 2FA prompt to you.

solutions.prompt: Submit the launch post to Hacker News, react on the GitHub release issue, tell #general in Slack, then --dry-run the rest.
solutions.major: Front page or bust, soldier. Every channel, one voice: yours.

faq.q: Does it vote on Hacker News?
faq.a: Never. It submits stories and comments, nothing else. Link submissions are capped at 2 per profile per day.

faq.q: Does Blowhorn install a Slack app?
faq.a: No. Blowhorn works on Slack through Slack's API and sends as you, with your Slack session linked through the Blowhorn extension or a Slack token you add.

faq.q: How does it post to each network?
faq.a: LinkedIn, X, Reddit and Hacker News: Blowhorn types in your own Chrome, signed in as you. Slack, Bluesky and GitHub go through their APIs.

faq.q: What about Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube?

solutions.name: Multi-profile
solutions.title: Blowhorn for many profiles
solutions.headline: Many profiles. Real Chrome. No disguises.
solutions.lead: Every brand, founder and project you speak for, from one menu bar. Each profile runs in its own real Chrome profile, signed in as itself.
solutions.description: Run many brand, founder and project profiles from one desk: each in its own real Chrome profile, no fake fingerprints, from one coordinated queue.

art.alt: Mouse Marine, a mallard in a green beret riding a gold trackball on a small tank through teal water, cursor spear raised

pains.b: Antidetect browsers fake a fingerprint per profile. That's a disguise, and a hard one to explain.
Profiles live on one computer. Close it, or move to another, and the plan stays behind.
You still post by hand in every profile. There's no queue, no schedule and no amplify.

gets.b: Each Blowhorn profile maps to its own Chrome profile on each computer. No fake fingerprints.
One profile, one automation per platform, at a time. A second run waits rather than fighting the first.
Every computer you set up works from the same queue, coordinated so the same post isn't sent from two of them.
Schedule posts, amplify from every profile and dry-run first. Pause one action, one computer or all of them.

solutions.prompt: Queue this announcement for every brand profile on Thursday 10:00, have the founder profiles amplify it, then --dry-run.
solutions.major: One soldier, many uniforms. Every one of them real.

faq.a: No. Blowhorn is real Chrome, signed in as each profile. It does the typing and clicking.

link.label: See what sites can read about your browser

faq.q: Can two automations use one profile at once?
faq.a: Not on the same platform. While one run holds a profile's LinkedIn session, a second one waits. Different platforms can run side by side.
Not today. Blowhorn runs on macOS 13 or newer, as the desktop app or the Python CLI.
